Title: Azure Redis Cache: Scaling preview and more features

Body.Content: The Azure Redis Cache service now allows you to scale up or scale down your cache. Apart from scaling, there are new performance counters available in the portal that you can use to monitor the performance of your cache. Please read this post for more details: Azure Redis Cache Updates for June 2015.
